author: Stahly
description:
After long years of hardship, fans of the pointy-eared Eldar have recently been blessed with many new plastic kits. Including the new Aeldari Corsairs and the Vyper / Starfang. Reason enough to trawl through our archive for the 5 best Aeldari posts to inspire you for your next hobby project. Feast your eyes on the following showcase posts, tutorials, and reviews.

The post Top 5: Our best Aeldari posts appeared first on Tale of Painters.
